# DNSChecker — Network Intelligence & Security Tools

> DNSChecker (https://www.dnschecker.space) is a free, real-time network intelligence, DNS resolution, IP geolocation, and cyber-reputation platform built for developers, DevOps engineers, sysadmins, and cybersecurity analysts.

## Core Tools

- [My IP Address Checker](https://www.dnschecker.space/my-ip): Detect your device's public IPv4/IPv6 address, ISP, ASN, reverse DNS, and connection metadata.
- [IP Address Lookup](https://www.dnschecker.space/lookup): Inspect any target IP or domain for physical coordinates, autonomous system, hosting datacenter, and proxy/VPN flags.
- [DNS Propagation & Record Lookup](https://www.dnschecker.space/dns): Query authoritative DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, CAA) with real-time TTL evaluation.
- [WHOIS Domain Lookup](https://www.dnschecker.space/whois): Inspect domain registrar, registration date, expiry countdown, domain status codes (EPP), and nameserver delegation.
- [SSL/TLS Certificate Checker](https://www.dnschecker.space/ssl): Verify TLS handshake validity, certificate chain integrity, issuing CA, expiration countdown, and SAN host coverage.
- [Security Headers Scanner](https://www.dnschecker.space/headers): Grade server defense posture against OWASP standards (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy).
- [IP & Domain Blacklist Check](https://www.dnschecker.space/blacklist): Query 50+ Real-time Blackhole Lists (DNSBL / RBL) including Spamhaus, AbuseIPDB, and Barracuda.
- [Email Security & Deliverability](https://www.dnschecker.space/email): Audit MX records, SPF policy authorization, DKIM records, DMARC alignment, and disposable email detection.
- [Port Scanner & Service Probe](https://www.dnschecker.space/ports): Probe common server ports (80, 443, 22, 21, 25, 3306, 25565) to verify firewall forwarding and reachability.
- [IP Geolocation Tracker](https://www.dnschecker.space/geo): Map any IP address to city, region, country, postal code, and latitude/longitude coordinates.
- [Hosting Provider Check](https://www.dnschecker.space/hosting): Discover datacenter host, upstream ISP, server environment, and ASN peering information.
- [All Network Tools Arsenal](https://www.dnschecker.space/tools): Complete index of all 10+ free network diagnostic and cybersecurity lookups.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://www.dnschecker.space/sitemap): Comprehensive directory of all tools and published articles.

## Knowledge Base & Engineering Guides

- [What Is My IP Address?](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/what-is-my-ip-address): Complete guide to public WAN, private LAN, IPv4, IPv6, and router NAT translation.
- [How to Find IP Address in Windows CMD](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-find-ip-address-in-windows-cmd): Tutorial on ipconfig, PowerShell, and checking external public IPs in terminal.
- [IPv4 vs IPv6 Explained](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/ipv4-vs-ipv6-explained): Differences, packet header simplification, speed comparisons, and dual-stack adoption.
- [How DNS Lookup Works](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-dns-lookup-works): Recursive resolvers, root servers, TLD nameservers, and query sequence.
- [How to Check DNS Propagation](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-dns-propagation): Worldwide verification, TTL caching countdowns, and zero-downtime migration strategies.
- [How to Check IP Blacklists](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-ip-blacklists): Query 50+ DNSBL and RBL registries, find blacklist causes, and delisting workflows.
- [How to Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-spf-dkim-dmarc): Complete email deliverability guide to meet Google and Yahoo anti-spoofing requirements.
- [How to Check SSL Certificates](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-ssl-certificates): Verify expiry, intermediate certificate chains, TLS 1.3 ciphers, and OpenSSL commands.
- [How to Find Website Hosting IP](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-find-website-hosting-ip): Locate true host, ASN, datacenter, and unmask origin servers behind reverse proxies.
- [How to Check Open Ports](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-open-ports): Audit server firewalls, port scanning (22, 80, 443, 3389, 3306), and TCP/UDP risks.
- [What Is Reverse DNS Lookup?](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/what-is-reverse-dns-lookup): PTR records, in-addr.arpa resolution, and mail server FCrDNS verification.
- [How to Troubleshoot DNS Errors](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-troubleshoot-dns-errors): Fix NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, and browser DNS probe errors with dig and traceroute.
- [What Are DNS A, AAAA, MX and TXT Records?](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/what-are-dns-records-a-aaaa-mx-txt): Comprehensive DNS record type syntax and usage guide.
- [How to Check Website Security Headers](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/how-to-check-website-security-headers): Audit HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and Referrer-Policy.
- [What Is DNSSEC?](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/what-is-dnssec-guide): Digital cryptographic signatures (RRSIG, DNSKEY, DS) preventing DNS cache poisoning.
- [Minecraft Server IP Checker](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/ip-checker-minecraft): Finding, testing, and protecting game servers with port 25565 and SRV records.
- [WebRTC & VPN Leak Test](https://www.dnschecker.space/blog/webrtc-vpn-leak-test): Check if real public IP is exposed through WebRTC STUN requests while on VPN.

## Technical Specifications

- **Pricing:** 100% Free, no registration or credit card required.
- **Protocol Support:** IPv4, IPv6, DNS over UDP/TCP, TLS 1.2 / 1.3, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2.
- **Accuracy:** Live real-time public registry lookups (ICANN, Regional Internet Registries ARIN/RIPE/APNIC, Root Nameservers).
- **Security:** Strict read-only diagnostic telemetry; never stores user passwords or private keys.
